Bench: Kuldeep Mathur  HIGH COURT OF JUDICATURE FOR RAJASTHAN AT  JODHPUR  S.B. Criminal Appeal No. 60/2023 Pradeep @ Praveen Kumar S/o Rajesh Kumar, Aged About 40 Years, B/c Jat, R/o Tihai, P.s. Ramgarh Sethan, Dist. Sikar (Raj.).
(At Present Lodged In Sub Jail, Merta).

entities.text: HIGH COURT OF JUDICATURE FOR RAJASTHAN AT  JODHPUR
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Suraj Prakash S/o Banna Ram, B/c Meghwal, R/o Sirsla,

Dist. Nagaur (Raj.).
 ----Respondents For Appellant(s) : Mr. Akash Goyal

For Respondent(s) : Ms. Anita Gehlot, PP  HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE KULDEEP MATHUR Order 20/01/2023 The instant appeal has been filed under Section 14(A)(2) of the SC/ST (Prevention of Atrocities) Act on behalf of the appellant, who is in custody in connection with FIR No.112/2011 registered at Police Station Kuchera, District Nagaur, for the offences under Sections 363, 366-A, 342, 354, 376(2)(g) of IPC and Section 3(1)
(xii) and 3(2)(v) of SC/ST Act.
Heard learned counsel for the appellant and Public Prosecutor for the State.
Perused the material available on record.

It is submitted by learned counsel for the appellant that the co-accused-Bheru Ram S/o Jassa Ram has already been granted bail by a co-ordinate Bench of this Court vide order dated 29.09.2016 in S.B. Criminal Misc. 3rd Bail application No.8942/2016.

entities.text: S.B. Criminal Misc. 3rd Bail application No.8942/2016
entities.label: CASE_NUMBER

sentences.text: He further submits that the appellant is in judicial (2 of 2) [CRLAS-60/2023] custody since long and the trial of the case will take sufficiently long time to conclude.
Thus, learned counsel submits that benefit of bail may be extended to the appellant.

Having regard to the totality of facts and circumstances as available on record and upon consideration of the arguments advanced without commenting on the merits of the case, this Court deems it proper to enlarge the appellant on bail.
Consequently, the instant appeal is allowed.
The impugned order dated 14.11.2022 passed by the Special Judge, SC/ST (Prevention of Atrocities) Act Cases, Merta, District Nagaur is set aside.

entities.text: Special Judge, SC/ST (Prevention of Atrocities) Act Cases, Merta
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: It is ordered that the accused-appellant Pradeep @ Praveen Kumar S/o Rajesh Kumar arrested in connection with aforesaid FIR, shall be released on bail, if not wanted in any other case, provided him furnish a personal bond of Rs.1,00,000/- and two sureties of Rs.50,000/- each to the satisfaction of the learned lower Court with the stipulation to appear before that Court on all dates of hearing and as and when called upon to do so.
